statements.attributed: reported the successful synthesis of high-entropy oxides with a rocksalt structure
statements.quote: The first report on the successful synthesis of high-entropy oxides (HEOs) with a rocksalt structure formed from equimolar amounts of five transition metals was published in 2015 by Rost et al. In the following years, the concept was developed further by Djenadic et al., Bérardan et al., and Dąbrowa et al., who synthesized five rare-earth CaF2-type oxides, five transition metals and lithium oxides, and transition metal spinel oxide, respectively.
